run_Evaluator_evaluate_sequence: run the Evaluator evaluate_sequence method to evaluate a CoTracker model on a test dataloader and return metrics
run_Evaluator_compute_metrics: run the Evaluator compute_metrics method to compute tracking accuracy metrics for tapvid or dynamic_replica datasets
create_Evaluator_instance: create an Evaluator instance with an experiment directory path for CoTracker model evaluation and visualization
test_Evaluator_tapvid_evaluation: test the Evaluator evaluate_sequence method with a tapvid dataset to compute query-based tracking metrics
test_Evaluator_online_model: test the Evaluator evaluate_sequence method with a CoTrackerThreeOnline model for online tracking evaluation
